2020.text: We have to work at the speed of the internet , while also being among the most reliable organizations on it. We need to invent a mode of working which marries the intensity that startups often prize with sustainable careers and organizational memory. We want the uptime for Stripe to be measured in decades; we cannot afford to burn our archives every 18 months due to turnover.
